title: A Budyko evaporation change agrees with the eastern US post-1997 runoff offset but cannot make the south-east Australian rain-slope loss, also at equal aridity (CAMELS, 1951-2025)
abstract: Question: after 1997, south-east Australian (SE-AU) runoff lost about one fifth of its rain slope, while eastern US (East-US) runoff had a constant offset. Can one increase of catchment evaporation, seen at two aridity levels, make both forms? Approach: for Fu's Budyko equation we showed that small changes of the evaporation parameter w, of evaporative demand E0 or of effective rain give r/o <= 1 for w 1.3-6 and aridity 0.2-6, where r is the relative change of the rain slope and o the relative offset. We fitted the Fu equation with a previous-year rain term to 1951-1996 for 175 SE-AU, 260 East-US, 279 West-US and 25 south-west Western Australian CAMELS catchments. Then we fitted one-parameter changes to 2010-end, with five rain and two E0 products. Intervals are cluster-bootstrap 95% intervals. Results: SE-AU had r - o below 0 with every product (AGCD -0.090, -0.115 to -0.051; SILO -0.069; CRU -0.157; Morton E0 -0.075). The observed slope loss (r = -0.220) was larger than the E0, effective-rain and w predictions (-0.128, -0.097, -0.044). The relative deficit was 6.9% in dry years and 16.5% in wet years. East-US (r = -0.003, o = -0.055) agreed with all evaporation changes, and measured CRU PET explained 35% of its mean deficit. At equal aridity (0.5-1.2), the SE-AU minus East-US difference in r was -0.205 (-0.259 to -0.136). A 1981-1996 placebo, the dry 1997-2009 period and the groundwater-decline region SW-WA were inside the bound. Post hoc checks of rain season, multi-year rain memory and rain-error attenuation (instrumented slopes) did not remove the SE-AU slope loss. Conclusion: the East-US offset agrees with an evaporation increase. The SE-AU change needs a mechanism that removes a fraction of the extra runoff in wet years. Limitations: Fu family and small-change theory; annual scale; several post hoc tests; spatial bootstrap only; E0 products disagree for SE-AU; the SE-AU cause was not identified.
